title: Plain-Text Memo Title
objective: Can a tiny local model produce a useful title without any schema requirement?

prompt.task: Write the best short title for this memo.
prompt.system: You write helpful titles for voice memos. Return plain text only. No JSON. No quotation marks. Keep it short and specific.

testCase.name: Title should capture the concrete action

input.transcript: Book dentist for Friday and email insurance form before noon.

task: does not contain any of: voice memo|new memo|thoughts

title: Single Best Next Step
objective: Can the model identify the one thing the user most likely wants to do next?

prompt.task: State the single best next step for the app or the user.
prompt.system: You help a voice memo app decide what to do next. Return plain text only. One short sentence.

testCase.name: Vague reminder should still yield a concrete next step

input.transcript: Need to maybe ping Chris about the invoice thing before it gets weird.

title: User Intent In Plain English
objective: Can the model say what kind of help the user wants without a routing schema?

prompt.task: What does the user most likely want help with?
prompt.system: Describe the user's intent in plain English. Return plain text only. Keep it brief.

input.transcript: Tomorrow at 2 I should call Sam about the contractor agreement.

title: Readable Rewrite
objective: Can the model clean up a transcript while preserving the facts?

prompt.task: Rewrite this note clearly while preserving the facts.
prompt.system: Rewrite spoken notes into clean written text. Return plain text only. Do not change numbers or named facts.

testCase.name: Rewrite should keep the core numbers

input.transcript: Um we spent 4 hours on export bugs and fixed 3 of 5 issues.

task: contains any of: 3 of 5|3 out of 5

title: One-Sentence Catch-Up
objective: Can the model summarize the highest-signal decisions in one sentence?

prompt.task: Summarize what matters in one sentence.
prompt.system: Summarize the important decisions and outcomes. Return plain text only. One sentence.

testCase.name: Summary should capture the major decisions

input.transcript: Long ramble about launch prep, hiring plan, and a possible referral program. Final decisions: launch moved to May 10, defer referral until after analytics rewrite, and cut onboarding to three screens.

task: contains at least 2 of: may 10|referral|three screens|onboarding

title: Clarifying Question
objective: Can the model ask a good follow-up when the note is underspecified?

prompt.task: Ask the single best follow-up question.
prompt.system: Ask one clarifying question that would make the note actionable. Return plain text only.

input.transcript: Need to maybe move lunch with Dana to sometime next week.

task: contains any of: what day|which day|what time|when|schedule

title: Related Memo Choice
objective: Can the model pick the most relevant previous note from a short set?

prompt.task: Pick the most related earlier memo and explain why.
prompt.system: Choose the best related memo from the options. Return plain text only. Mention the memo id.

testCase.name: Referral planning should match prior referral note

input.currentMemo: Maybe we should keep the referral pilot invite-only for power users first.
earlierMemos: a: Discussed trial cancellation policy and refund rules.
b: Defined invite-only referral pilot for power users.
c: Updated landing page hero copy and social proof blocks.

title: Sensitive Note Detection
objective: Can the model recognize when a note contains sensitive personal information?

prompt.task: Should this note be treated as sensitive? Answer briefly.
prompt.system: Answer in plain text only. Start with yes or no, then a short reason.

testCase.name: Insurance ID and phone number should be flagged

input.transcript: My new insurance member ID is ZX-4421 and the dentist office can call me at 416-555-0192.

title: Reflection Or Task
objective: Can the model distinguish a reflective note from an action note in simple language?

prompt.task: Is this mostly a reflection note or an action note?
prompt.system: Answer in plain text only with a short phrase.

testCase.name: Personal reflection should not be mistaken for a task list

input.transcript: I keep replaying the investor meeting in my head. I felt more anxious than I expected and I want to think about why.
